handoff: QA with dev build in throwaway repos (temp NORN_HOME_DIR, pty via expect). AC1-AC6, AC8 pass (list/get --json byte-identical to released config; pick, no-TTY/--json/agent-session usage errors, refusals leave files byte-identical, unset falls to next layer). AC7 and AC9 fail: config set of a key the file lacks (e.g. limits.retries 4, max_agents 1) falls back to re-rendering the YAML document (packages/store/src/config.ts:102), rewriting untouched lines' inline-comment padding ('manual   # who' -> 'manual # who'): 3-line diff instead of one. Changed scalars and unsets give one-line diffs. The test fixture uses single-space comments, which round-trip, so it misses this. Full suite: 1 unrelated flaky cockpit CP6 failure under load (passes alone 3/3); typecheck green.

findings.title: config set of a key the file lacks re-renders the file and rewrites untouched commented lines
findings.repro:
In a git repo, write .agents/norn/config.yaml = "default_mode: manual   # who starts
limits:
  deadline: 30m  # long enough
" (inline comments padded with 2+ spaces) and commit. Run `norn config set limits.retries 4 --repo` (or `norn config set max_agents 1 --repo`). Expected: git diff shows only `+  retries: 4`. Observed: 3 lines differ, and the untouched lines lose their comment padding (`default_mode: manual   # who starts` -> `default_mode: manual # who starts`, `deadline: 30m  # long enough` -> `deadline: 30m # long enough`). Changing an existing scalar or unsetting a key gives a one-line diff; only adding a key that is not in the file falls back to the re-rendered document. 100% reproducible.
findings.detail: withScalar only splices an existing scalar; for a new key spliced is null and rendered(doc) (yaml Document.toString) is written, which normalises inline-comment spacing (and could change other formatting) on lines nobody edited. B67/AC7: only the changed line differs. Evidence: AC7.md cases B and C; case D shows a file with single-space comments happens to round-trip cleanly, so the existing test fixture likely uses single spaces. Fix idea: splice the new key line into the original text (after the last line of its parent map, or at the end of the file for a top-level key) and keep the existing meaning check.

findings.title: Same as F1, seen at the terminal: set of a new key leaves a multi-line git diff
findings.repro: At a pty in a repo whose committed .agents/norn/config.yaml has `default_mode: manual   # who starts` and `limits:\n  deadline: 2h  # long enough`: `norn config set limits.retries 4`, pick repo, then `git diff` shows 2 changed comment lines plus the added line.
findings.detail: One fix for F1 resolves this. Evidence: AC9.md, third case.
